newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume firms.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume firms.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume edged higher to 935 kilos on Wednesday from Tuesday's 903 kilos, on physical demand, dealers said.

Prices were mixed, firming in dollar terms to $342.65 an ounce from Tuesday's close of $342.00, but easing in lira terms to 1,605,900 per gram from 1,608,500 due to the Turkish currency's gains against the dollar.
"There wasn't much activity from the banks. Almost all the trade was due to demand coming from the free market, which is slowly picking up as the summer approaches," one dealer said.
The lira firmed to 145,500 to the dollar from Tuesday's 145,720, accounting for gold's slight rise in lira terms.
Most of the day's trade -- 750 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 61.5 percent of total trade conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
